e: From ad (“advertisement”) + block, a genericized name from AdBlock or Adblock Plus.

q: If adblockers do continue to prove popular with users, they could also be a major weapon in Apple’s arsenal against its key competitor, Google.
2015 September 17, Alex Hern, “Adblockers shoot up iOS 9 app charts on day one”, in The Guardian:

Peace isn’t his first entry into adblocking: a side-effect of Instapaper, the first of a class of apps which download content to read off-line, was stripping the adverts from saved content, in order to make them cleaner and easier to read.
